I.A. No.3016 of 2025 09/08.05.2025
By way of I.A. No.3016 of 2025, the appellant has renewed his
prayer to suspend the sentence and release him on bail, during the pendency of this criminal appeal.
There is direct and specific allegation against the appellant to commit rape on a minor girl and medical report has also supported the same.
Prima facie, ground is not disclosed for substantial doubt about the conviction.

2. Mrs. Ritu Kumar, learned counsel appearing for the appellant by way of pressing the said I.A.
submits that the appellant is in custody since 17.08.2017 and in view of that, he may kindly be
released on bail.
3.  Mr. Vineet Kumar Vashistha, learned counsel for the State opposed the prayer and submits that the act of the appellant is heinous and twice the prayer for bail has been rejected.
opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS: 4. The case is registered under Sections 376 and 506 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of the POCSO Act.
opennyai_summary.8_May_2025__decision:
Twice the said prayer was rejected by this Court vide order dated 10.04.2019 and 26.08.2021 respectively.
5. Looking into the seriousness of the offence, we are not inclined to grant bail to the appellant and,
as such, I.A. No.3016 of 2025 is rejected.

opennyai_summary.final__decision:
3. Having heard the parties and after perusing the material available on record, we are inclined to suspend the sentence and enlarge the appellant on bail, for the reason that out of fifteen years of rigorous imprisonment imposed by the Trial Court, the appellant has already undergone more than eight years of incarceration, and thus as per law, he is entitled to such relief.
Ordered accordingly.
4. The impugned order stands set aside and the appellant shall be released on bail on appropriate terms and conditions as may be fixed by the concerned Trial Court, unless and until he is required in any other case.
5. To comply with the same, the appellant shall be produced before the Trial Court forthwith.
6. Accordingly, the appeal stands allowed.
7. Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.
